titleEn: Shortest Distance to Target String in a Circular Array
title: 到目标字符串的最短距离
summary: 在环形字符串数组中从 startIndex 出发，每步可向前或向后移动一格，求到任一 target 位置的最少步数，不存在返回负一。
insight: 枚举所有等于 target 的下标 i，普通距离为 abs(i-start)，环形另一方向距离为 n-abs，取二者较小值并更新全局最小。
pitfalls: 起点已是目标时答案为零

solutions.title: 枚举目标位置计算环形距离
solutions.idea: 每个目标位置常数时间求最短环距。
steps: 扫描 words 的每个下标 i
扫描后 answer 未更新则返回 -1，否则返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int closetTarget(String[] words,String target,int startIndex){int answer=words.length+1;for(int i=0;i<words.length;i++)if(words[i].equals(target)){int difference=Math.abs(i-startIndex);answer=Math.min(answer,Math.min(difference,words.length-difference));}return answer>words.length?-1:answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun closetTarget(words:Array<String>,target:String,startIndex:Int):Int{var answer=words.size+1;for(i in words.indices)if(words[i]==target){val difference=kotlin.math.abs(i-startIndex);answer=minOf(answer,difference,words.size-difference)};return if(answer>words.size)-1 else answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int closetTarget(vector<string>& words,string target,int startIndex){int answer=words.size()+1;for(int i=0;i<(int)words.size();++i)if(words[i]==target){int difference=abs(i-startIndex);answer=min({answer,difference,(int)words.size()-difference});}return answer>(int)words.size()?-1:answer;} };
